title: AStages FTB Quests
description: Adds a bridge between AStages and FTB Quests.
body:
## AStages-FTB Quests Bridge

This lightweight mod adds a simple integration between **[AStages](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/astages)** and **[FTB Quests](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ftb-quests-forgeskills)**.  
It allows stage rewards in the quest tree to **grant or remove stages** to both server and player.

### Features

*   Assign a stage when a quest is completed.
*   Grant stage to both server and player scope.
*   Stage can be added or removed.
*   Fantastic easy-to-use configuration overlay.

> Requires both AStages and FTB QUESTS to be installed.

### Customization

Stages can be granted or removed to both server and player by adding a simple reward to the quest tree.  
See the **Wiki** for syntax and examples.
